006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
010
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.math.BigDecimal;
013import java.math.MathContext;
014import java.util.List;
015
016import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDecimalItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
020import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
021import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
026 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#decimal">decimal</a>
027 * data type.
028 */
029public class DecimalAdapter
030    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<BigDecimal, IDecimalItem> {
031  @NonNull
032  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
033      List.of(
034          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "decimal")));
035
036  DecimalAdapter() {
037    super(BigDecimal.class, IDecimalItem.class, IDecimalItem::cast);
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Provides a standardized math context to use with {@link BigDecimal}
042   * operations.
043   * <p>
044   * This math context was chosen for decimal arithmetic operations, since
045   * DECIMAL64 provides a precision of 16 digits, which is sufficient for most
046   * business calculations while maintaining reasonable performance.
047   *
048   * @return the standardized math context
049   */
050  @SuppressWarnings("null")
051  @NonNull
052  public static MathContext mathContext() {
053    return MathContext.DECIMAL64;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
058    return NAMES;
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
063    return JsonFormatTypes.NUMBER;
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public BigDecimal parse(String value) {
068    return new BigDecimal(value, mathContext());
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  public void writeJsonValue(Object value, JsonGenerator generator) throws IOException {
073    try {
074      generator.writeNumber((BigDecimal) value);
075    } catch (ClassCastException ex) {
076      throw new IOException(ex);
077    }
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  public BigDecimal copy(Object obj) {
082    // a BigDecimal is immutable
083    return (BigDecimal) obj;
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public IDecimalItem newItem(Object value) {
088    BigDecimal item = toValue(value);
089    return IDecimalItem.valueOf(item);
090  }
091}
